description: The free Fifty Asks check: we ask ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini the questions a customer would ask for your trade and town, fifty times in all, and record who each one names first. You get a short written report by email: who gets named, whether you do, and the page facts the named businesses share. Free, no card, no contract. We do not promise rankings or how often an assistant names you. Booked by an agent: delivered within 2 business days instead of 5.
